solutions.title: Iterative DFS
solutions.strategy: Depth-first search from the start cell with an explicit stack, repainting only matching-color neighbors.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each cell in the connected component is visited at most once, bounded by the whole grid.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The explicit stack can contain a path through the entire grid in the worst case.

solutions.title: Iterative BFS
solutions.strategy: Use a queue to expand the component layer by layer and avoid recursion-depth risk.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each cell can be enqueued and recolored once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The queue can hold a large frontier in the grid.
